description: This file implements the A2A Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0) for sending messages to agents, including functions for non-streaming and streaming message requests, metadata extraction, and handling responses with artifacts and progress updates.

methods.name: extractA2AMetadata
methods.description: Extracts task metadata from A2A JSON-RPC response results, including task ID, context ID, status, and custom metadata.

methods.name: makeA2ASendMessageRequest
methods.description: Sends a non-streaming message to an A2A agent using JSON-RPC 2.0, handles response, extracts text and metadata, and invokes callbacks.

methods.name: makeA2AStreamMessageRequest
methods.description: Sends a streaming message to an A2A agent using JSON-RPC 2.0 with NDJSON responses, processes streaming chunks, updates text, and extracts metadata.
